messages:
Priya K: Quick heads-up — the cURL example in guides/runtime/batching.md is returning a 403 in staging. screenshot attached. :(

docs-bot: automated link-scan: detected 403 on https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-internal/samples/batch-example.json (guides/runtime/batching.md:42)

Lin H: ack. looks like the snippet is still pointing at the internal bucket. we shouldn't expose that. we can either rehost to s3-public or point to a gist.

Sam B: gist would be fastest for a sample. less infra work and preview deploy won't block.

Taylor: opened a tiny PR to swap the URL to a public gist and add a short note about using signed URLs for private data — https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1234 (needs reviewer)

Priya K: thanks @Taylor. @Lin H / @Sam B can one of you review the PR? also pls confirm the example still works with the Authorization header removed (it's meant to be public).

Lin H: I can review in ~30m. quick check: current curl in the doc is:
```
curl -X GET "https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-internal/samples/batch-example.json" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```
If we switch to the gist we should remove the Auth header and update the snippet accordingly.

Sam B: verified gist approach locally — public raw URL works with the same example body. I'll leave a comment on the PR about removal of Auth header.

infra-ops: can you also mirror a copy to s3-public for long-term if we prefer that over gist? prefer a canonical host under our control.

infra-ops: can do. will upload to s3-public and post the URL here in ~20m. note: will set Cache-Control to 1d and make it public-read.

Taylor: updated PR to use the raw gist URL and removed the auth header. added a one-line footnote: "Sample file is public; do not include private keys in examples."

Priya K: perfect. once infra posts the s3-public URL we can either land the gist PR for now and follow up with a small PR to point to s3-public, or wait for infra. leaning toward land-now (gist) to unblock the onboarding flow and then switch later.

Lin H: +1 to land-now. I'll approve the PR after a quick grammar pass. :eyes:

docs-bot: CI preview built: https://deploy-preview.redwood.dev/1234 — runtime/batching.md snippet updated (staging preview)

Priya K: awesome — thanks everyone. tagging this as low-priority follow-up to swap to s3-public when infra confirms. I'll add a tiny ticket to the docs backlog. :thumbsup:

infra-ops: uploaded public copy: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-public/samples/batch-example.json — sharing for follow-up PR.

Sam B: noted. I'll open the follow-up PR to switch from gist -> s3-public after today's standup.

Taylor: landed the gist PR; merged. thanks all.

Priya K: great, closing loop. if anyone sees other staging 403s pls ping here or drop them in #help.
